risk_summary: The disclosure identifies significant financial reporting and governance risk, including restatement of multiple quarterly periods, an investigation covering 63 acquisitions, and termination of the CFO and two accounting personnel. Although the underlying business description is detailed, substantial boilerplate and reliance on estimates and adjusted EBITDA may reduce comparability and obscure underlying performance. The excerpt does not quantify the restatement impact or provide sufficient detail on control remediation and remaining exposure.
